Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!
 Are you a new Umamusume trainer? Are you looking to improve your skills? Then "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!" might be just the video series you need!
 

 Overview

 To celebrate the release of Umamusume: Pretty Derby, we've prepared a series of videos to help budding trainers get to grips with how to play the game!
 
 In these videos, Sakura Bakushin O and the other Umamusume will answer all of your pressing questions, explaining in easy-to-understand terms how to go about guiding your trainee!
 
 

 Video Contents

 This video series is made up of 8 episodes in total.
 
 [[[Episode 1: Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 2: Choosing Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 3: I Don't Want to Fail Training!]]]
 [[[Episode 4: Mood is Key!]]
 [[[Episode 5: Choosing a Race]]]
 [[[Episode 6: Running Style]]]
 [[[Episode 7: Last Spurt and Skills]]]
 [[[Episode 8: Inspiration]]]
 
 

 How to View the Videos

  Check out the videos here!
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbRq7_wpPI8lplzYnXcq2WIuUMA3-iLwH
 
 We hope you'll take the opportunity to enjoy these special videos and get to grips with training your Umamusume!
 
 All together now, trainers... Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!

raw.message:
The following is a list of issues we know to be affecting the game.

 ■ Issues Being Worked On
 [Update: 12:30 a.m., Jun 26 (UTC)]
 • When using tablet mode in the Steam version, the game may not respond to touch input.


 ■ Resolved Issues
 [Update: 9:20 a.m., Jul 31, 2026 (UTC)]
 • Event Bonus Umamusume details do not display correctly when viewing the Career Profile of an ongoing Independent Training session.

 (This issue only affects the display; the Event Bonus effect is correctly applied to Event Points received.)

 [Update: 9:40 a.m., Jul 29, 2026 (UTC)]
 • An error was found in the character text on the "Wings of Steam and Steel" story event screen.

 Correct text: UWAAAAAH! Urgh... I was just thinking about the researcher we helped... I'm shooo gwad it worked out!

 [Update: 8:30 a.m., Jul 27, 2026 (UTC)]
 • An error with code 205 can occur when starting Independent Training for Trackblazer: Start of the Climax with the following Trainee Umamusume:

 • Matikanetannhauser
 • Sweep Tosho

 [Update: 6:20 a.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC)]
 • Animations do not match corresponding Home screen voice lines when certain Umamusume are set to their Casual Wear outfits.

 [Update: 3:15 a.m., Jul 3, 2026 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!", the game may freeze when selecting "Watch Main Race" in certain Team Races.

 (If you encounter this issue, it should be possible to progress the Career by restarting the game and selecting "See All Race Results" instead.)
 • In the story event "Make a Splash! Summer Showdown! ☆," an incorrect summary is displayed below the image introducing the event. The correct text is as follows:

 Correct text: The midsummer Splash Recreation event is underway! Mejiro McQueen finds herself roped into the competition by Gold Ship, and with both unwilling to back down, the two face off! Meanwhile, competition is sparking off between Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky. Who will win the action-packed water pistol battle?

 [Update: 6:00 p.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC)]
 • Certain Career Events for Yaeno Muteki are displayed in Japanese.

 • In the Career Scenario "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!", unintended teams may appear in Team Races.

 (This issue does not affect Career progress.)

 [Update: 6:06 p.m., Jun 27 (UTC)]
 • In the event "Aim for the Stars! Dream Team", the number of Scout Race Tickets is not being updated even after the scheduled time has passed.

 [Update: 8:20 a.m., Apr 20 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," using training items on attributes greater than 1,000 may cause digits to be cut off, resulting in an incorrect value being displayed.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the displayed value; the actual attribute value is calculated correctly.)

 [Update: 11:30 a.m., Apr 1 (UTC)]
 • Part of the mission text for Part 3 of the Special Missions "Tracen Special: Training the Trainer" contains an error.

 Incorrect: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 3 attributes at S rank or better
 Correct: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 2 attributes at S rank or better
 (Please note that this issue is only present in the mission text; completing a Career playthrough with any 2 attributes at S rank or better will result in clearing the mission.)

 [Update: 8:30 a.m., Mar 26 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," when purchasing certain items from the Pro Shop with the automatic use option enabled, the "Used" badge is displayed in Japanese.

 (For more information on automatic use of training items, please refer to Trackblazer: Start of the Climax under Career in Help.)

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Feb 18 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version, if the Agenda is open in the right-hand menu when starting a Recreation minigame, certain icons in the Scheduled Races screen display incorrectly.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the display; Career gameplay outcomes are not affected. If you encounter this issue, you can return the display to normal by re-opening the Agenda after navigating to a different tab.)

 [Update: 11:09 a.m., Jan 30 (UTC)]
 • In the story event "Blossoming Beginnings! New Year's Karuta Showdown," the Event Bonus effect of applicable Support Cards is not displayed correctly, even if they are in the Trainer's possession.

   (Please note that this issue only affects the display; when completing a Career, the Event Bonus effect is correctly applied to the Event Points received.)
 
 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • The text regarding the requirements for obtaining the "Super Sprinter" epithet is currently incorrect.

 Incorrect: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Stamina and Power of 1,200 or higher
 Correct: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Speed and Power of 1,200 or higher
 *This is only a display issue―the actual requirements for the epithet are correct.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version's Options menu, the options listed under Main Settings → Screen Orientation →　Graphics Settings do not change the graphics quality as indicated.

 (Currently, selecting the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed in this location instead switches between Windowed and Borderless Fullscreen display modes. To adjust graphics quality, please use the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed under Graphics → Quality on the same page.)

 [Update: 7:00 a.m., Jan 6 (UTC)]
 • An incorrect Umamusume icon displays in Room Matches and the Trophy Room.

 [Update: 6:45 a.m., Dec 26 (UTC)]
 • The parameters that can be gained from an event choice may actually be higher than what's displayed in the pop-up when checking its effects.

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Dec 17 (UTC)]
 • The Members screen cannot be scrolled when accessed from Invite under the Club menu.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Dec 2 (UTC)]
 • In some cases, the Current Promotion Line in Team Trials will display "0 pts".

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed; your actual score is unaffected.)

 [Update: 5:30 a.m., Nov 27 (UTC)]
 • The skill level for Agnes Digital's Unique Skill, "OMG! (ﾟ∀ﾟ) The Final Sprint! ☆", may sometimes not increase during the "Fan Fest" trainee event despite fulfilling the prerequisites.

 [Update: 9:30 a.m., Oct 3 (UTC)]
 • The number of completed missions is not properly displayed on the Missions icon on the Home screen even when there are mission rewards available to collect.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed on the Missions icon; mission rewards can still be collected by selecting the icon as usual. If you encounter this issue, restarting the game should cause the correct number to appear on the icon.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Oct 2 (UTC)]
 • Some errors were included in the Help text for the "Uma Quest: Epic Odyssey" story event.

 (The text has been fixed and any incorrect information has been removed.)

 [Update: 7:20 a.m., Oct 1 (UTC)]
 • On Android devices, an error is displayed repeatedly when starting a new game, after entering the user's country/region and birth date. It is possible to bypass this error and progress the game by selecting the Retry option twice.

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 21 (UTC)]
 • In the 10:00 p.m., Aug 20 (UTC) notice announcing new Spotlight Pretty Derby and Spotlight Support Card Scouts, the rarity of the SR Support Card "[The World's My Oyster] Seeking the Pearl" was incorrectly listed as SSR.

 (This issue was only present in the notice text; scout rates etc. were not affected.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 5 (UTC)]
 • When playing Team Trials on the Steam version of the game, trainers may be unable to proceed past the results screen.

 [Update: 12:40 p.m., Aug 1 (UTC)]
 • When attempting to purchase carats, an error listed with Error Code 102 can occur.

 [Update: 6:00 a.m., Jul 11 (UTC)]
 • The Main Mission "Link App Data" currently cannot be completed in the Steam version.

 • When using certain Android devices (Android 16), the app may not launch properly.

   These issues will be corrected in future updates.
 It may take some time before fixes can be implemented, so we ask for your patience.

 We sincerely apologize to any trainers who are inconvenienced by these issues.
raw.title: List of Known Issues

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., May 7, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., May 7 - 9:59 p.m., May 11, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater the rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to the notice that will be posted when the event begins, or Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.
raw.title: Transfer Requests now available!

At 10:00 p.m., May 14, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Taurus Cup is set to begin!

 Champions Meeting: Taurus Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., May 14 - 9:59 p.m., May 20, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., May 10 - 9:59 p.m., May 18, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., May 14, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., May 16, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., May 18, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., May 14 - 9:59 p.m., May 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., May 16 - 9:59 p.m., May 18, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., May 18 - 9:59 a.m., May 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., May 19 - 9:59 p.m., May 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., May 19 - 9:59 p.m., May 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Turf / 2,400m (Medium) / Left-Handed / Spring / Sunny / Firm

 Changes Starting May 2026

 Change 1

 The following change has been made to Career Rank requirements for registering Veteran Umamusume in the Open League.
 [Before Changes] Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 [After Changes] Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.

 The entry requirements for each league following the changes are as follows.
 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S cannot participate in the Open League.)

 Change 2

 Reward amounts and their requirements have been adjusted.

 ■ Across All Rounds
 The amount of attainable monies and support points has been increased.

 ■ Final Round
 The placement required to earn event-exclusive titles has been adjusted, making titles Gold and lower easier to acquire.
 (Please note that no changes have been made to the placement required to acquire Platinum titles.)

 For details on available rewards, refer to the League Selection screen or select Rewards on the Champions Meeting event screen during future events.

 Change 3

 Stars will be added to titles acquired more than once.
 Titles with stars will be displayed under your Rewards for Champions Meeting.

 Example: If you already have the Taurus Cup Platinum title and acquire it again, it will change to Taurus Cup Platinum ★.
 (Please note it will display this way under your Rewards for Champions Meeting.)

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Taurus Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Taurus Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Taurus Cup Platinum
 • Taurus Cup Gold
 • Taurus Cup Silver
 • Taurus Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Taurus Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in previous Champions Meetings, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately, and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

As of 9:59 p.m., May 29, 2026 (UTC), the story event "The Promised Hour: Silks & Three Riddles" has ended.
 Rewards will remain available to collect until 9:59 p.m., Jun 1, 2026 (UTC).
 During the reward collection period, you can access the story event's home screen to collect unreceived event mission rewards and play the Prize Derby.
 Any event story episodes that you have unlocked previously during the event period will remain viewable.

 Important Information

 1. Event Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 2. Prize Coins earned in this event will be converted into monies after the reward collection period has ended.
 3. You cannot complete event missions during the reward collection period, even if you fulfill their conditions.

raw.message:
New Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards!

 At 10:00 p.m., May 18, 2026 (UTC), a new Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout are set to begin!
 They will feature new Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards.

 Debut Trainee Umamusume

The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout will feature the 3★ Trainee Umamusume [Ma Chérie of the New Moon] Curren Chan and the 3★ Trainee Umamusume [Titania] Fine Motion!




 Debut Support Cards

 The Spotlight Support Card Scout will feature the following Support Cards!

 ■ SSR [Sunny Passion ♪] Haru Urara


 ■ SSR [Beloved Orchid Bouquet] Ikuno Dictus


 New Story Event: "The Promised Hour: Silks & Three Riddles"!

 Our next story event, titled "The Promised Hour: Silks & Three Riddles," will be kicking off at 10:00 p.m., May 18, 2026 (UTC)!


 This event revolves around the Beauty Dream Cup, a new competition held by Beauty Anshinzawa!
 Look forward to seeing your favorite Umamusume compete in an audition for the ultimate signature racewear!

 Story Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., May 18 - 9:59 p.m., May 29, 2026 (UTC)

 Event-Exclusive Support Card

 In the story event "The Promised Hour: Silks & Three Riddles," you'll be able to get your hands on copies of an exclusive Support Card!
 Make sure to progress this event while it's available to take advantage of this opportunity!
 The event's exclusive Support Card is as follows.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Support Card [Day I Dreamed Of] Rice Shower


 Look forward to more details as the date approaches!

 Champions Meeting: Gemini Cup Coming Soon!

 Our next Champions Meeting event is fast approaching, and this time it's the Gemini Cup!
 The race conditions have changed from last year.

Here are the race conditions to prepare for: Tokyo / Turf / 1,600m (Mile) / Left-Handed / Spring / Sunny / Firm

 League selection will begin at 10:00 p.m. on May 31, 2026 (UTC), and the main event kicks off at 10:00 p.m. on Jun 4, 2026 (UTC). Don't miss it!



 For more details, please refer to the notice that will be posted at the time of the event, or the Champions Meeting section in the in-game Help.

 Fuji Kiseki's Showtime Event Coming Soon!

 Fuji Kiseki's Showtime Event will be kicking off again in 2026!


 During the event, you can select between two modes, Normal Mode and Showtime Mode, when starting a Career.
 Selecting Showtime Mode will fill your Show Gauge at the end of your Career in exchange for making race competitors stronger.

 By filling your Show Gauge, you can earn additional rewards such as carats, Rainbow Crystal Shards, Books of Hints, and other various items!

 You can select your difficulty starting with Level 1 and continue to unlock higher levels one at a time by completing Careers.
 The harder the level you complete a Career on, the more you fill your Show Gauge. We hope you'll give it your best shot!

 Furthermore, from this time onward, you can increase the rate at which the Show Gauge increases by spending double the TP!
 We hope you try it!

 Fuji Kiseki's Showtime Event is set to kick off at 10:00 p.m., Jun 4, 2026 (UTC)! We hope you look forward to it!

 For details, please refer to the relevant notice that will be posted when the event begins.

 Spring G1 Celebration Part 2 is here!

 To celebrate the spring G1 race season, we're sending a gift of monies to all our trainers!
 There are special missions available too, so don't forget to take them on!

 Furthermore, an event that gives Star Pieces from Career Rewards is also coming soon!

https://umamusume.com/
 Umamusume: Pretty Derby Official X
https://x.com/umamusume_eng

 In Legend Races, you can challenge Legend Umamusume to obtain a variety of rewards.
 You can earn rewards just by entering the race, so train up your most suitable Umamusume and take on a Legend Umamusume!

 3:00 p.m., Jun 10 - 2:59 p.m., Jun 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Takarazuka Kinen / Hanshin / Turf / 2,200m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Inner / Spring / Sunny / Firm

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek

 To celebrate the new arrival of [Edomurasaki] Inari One, Episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story will be fully unlocked for a limited time!
 During the sneak peek period, you can watch the story episodes even without fulfilling their unlock conditions!

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek Period

 10:00 p.m., May 28 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 7, 2026 (UTC)

 Important Information

 1. During the sneak peek period, even if you have not obtained [Edomurasaki] Inari One, you can still watch Episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story!
 2. If you do watch Episodes 1 through 4 of Inari One's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Umamusume Archive experience.
 3. If you do not watch Episodes 1 through 4 of Inari One's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will not obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, or Umamusume Archive experience.
 4. After the sneak peek period has ended, any unwatched Umamusume Stories will once again become locked.
 5. Umamusume Stories can be viewed after the tutorial is completed.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Jun 4, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Gemini Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Gemini Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 4 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 10, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., May 31 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 8, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jun 4, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jun 6, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jun 8, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jun 4 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 6, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jun 6 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 8, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 8 - 9:59 a.m., Jun 9, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jun 9 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 9, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 9 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Turf / 1,600m (Mile) / Left-Handed / Spring / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Gemini Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Gemini Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Gemini Cup Platinum
 • Gemini Cup Gold
 • Gemini Cup Silver
 • Gemini Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Gemini Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby.

 We hope you're enjoying your time with the trainees!
 We'd like to offer a helping hand to get you to the peak of the URA Finale!

 

 Training Booster Giveaway

 In appreciation of your support, we've sent a 1,500-carat gift to all trainers!
 
 

 Gift Contents

 Carats × 1,500
 
 

 Eligible Trainers

 All trainers who start the game before 11:59 p.m., Jun 28, 2026 (UTC)
 
 

 How to Receive

 After completing the game's tutorial, select Presents on the Home screen to find your gift.
 If you don't see the gift in your Presents, try returning to the title screen and loading the game again.
 
 

 Gift Expiry

 Gifts will expire if not claimed within 30 days after they are sent to your Presents.
 Please be aware that expired gifts will automatically be deleted, so be sure to claim them before this happens.
 
 

 Important Information

  The details of this giveaway are subject to change without notice.

As of 10:00 p.m., Jun 4, 2026 (UTC), a Fuji Kiseki's Showtime event has begun!
 This event allows you to power up your Career playthroughs with Showtime Mode.

 Showtime Mode provides a greater challenge than a standard Career playthrough, but while it's active, you can fill up the Show Gauge to earn extra rewards at the end of your Career.
 The Show Gauge fills when you achieve your trainee's objectives, and can also be boosted by attempting higher difficulties.
 If you're confident in your skills, try to challenge your limits!

 How to Play

 1. After selecting a Career scenario, select Showtime Mode.
 2. Choose a Showtime Mode difficulty.
 (Initially, only the Lvl 1 difficulty is available.)
 Note: Higher difficulties can be unlocked by winning the Twinkle Star Climax in the Trackblazer: Start of the Climax scenario.

 Important Information

 2. You can make as many Showtime Mode attempts as you like during the event period.
 3. If you finish a Career playthrough after the event period ends, no extra rewards will be earned.
 (Other effects of Showtime Mode will remain active until the end of the playthrough.)
 4. Showtime Mode does not affect the difficulty of Team Races in the Unity Cup scenario.
 5. Once all Silk Hat Rewards have been obtained, any subsequent rewards will be drawn from the Cane Rewards.
 6. If the event period ends while a Career playthrough is in progress, it may not always be possible to resume that Career playthrough.
 7. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 8. Please be aware that while Showtime Mode boosts racers' attributes during Career races, it does not increase the attributes that your trainee can obtain.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jun 4, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.
 

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 4 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 8, 2026 (UTC)
 

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.
 

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.
 

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.
 

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.
 

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

At 10:00 p.m., Jun 24, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Cancer Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Cancer Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 24 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 30, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 21 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 28, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jun 24, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jun 26, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jun 28, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jun 24 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jun 26 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 28, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 28 - 9:59 a.m., Jun 29, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jun 29 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 29, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 29 - 9:59 p.m., Jun 30, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Hanshin / Turf / 2,200m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Inner / Summer / Cloudy / Good

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Cancer Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Cancer Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Cancer Cup Platinum
 • Cancer Cup Gold
 • Cancer Cup Silver
 • Cancer Cup Bronze

 If you re-obtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Cancer Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jun 25, 2026 (UTC), the StarHorse4 Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.
 In this special Transfer Request event, you might run into trainers who are a little different from usual, some of whom will even offer Rank 4 requests!
 There are rewards available that you won't find in regular Transfer Request events, so do your best to satisfy the trainers' conditions!

 Availability Period

 Part 1: 10:00 p.m., Jun 25 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 2, 2026 (UTC)
 Part 2: 10:00 p.m., Jul 2 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 9, 2026 (UTC)
 Part 3: 10:00 p.m., Jul 9 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated with each new part of the event.
 There are no request updates during the availability period for each part.

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Books of Hints / Textbooks of Hints
 • Rare Books of Hints / Rare Textbooks of Hints
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 • Star Fruit (new item)
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jun 25, 2026 (UTC), an Aim for the Stars! Dream Team event has begun!

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jun 25 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 3 (UTC)

 Reward Collection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 3 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 6 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 In Aim for the Stars! Dream Team events, your goal is to build the ultimate team of seven racers, including one of your own Veteran Umamusume and an additional six Umamusume scouted over the course of the event.
 Do your best to defeat the teams of other trainers from around the world, and for each matchup you win, you'll have the opportunity to scout a racer from the opposing team!

 Building a Team

 The team you will use to enter Scout Races consists of seven racers: one captain and six regular members.
 The captain can be selected freely from your own Veteran Umamusume.
 The regular members can be replaced when you are given the opportunity to scout racers during the event.

 Scout Races

 You can enter Scout Races using the team you have built.
 In each Scout Race, you will face the team of another trainer from around the world.
 All seven members of your team will face all seven members of the opponent's team in the same race.
 Based on the results of the race, you can earn rewards and Scout Points.

 Scout Race Tickets

 Each Scout Race costs one Scout Race Ticket to enter.
 Your Scout Race Tickets will replenish up to a maximum of five at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) on each day of the event.
 You can also obtain Scout Race Tickets from the event's Daily Missions, and up to five additional tickets can be replenished each day by using carats, Carrot Jelly items, or Carrot Jelly Mini items.
 (Please note that you can only replenish Scout Race Tickets using carats or items after consuming all Scout Race Tickets you currently possess.)

 Race Conditions

 Season: Summer
 Other race conditions are variable and change every three races entered.

 Scout Time

 Winning a Scout Race triggers a Scout Time opportunity.
 During Scout Time, you can consume Scout Points to replace one of your current team members with a racer from the team of the opponent you just faced.

 Team History

 Umamusume Records

 Each time you win a Scout Race, all racers in the winning team will be added to your Umamusume Records roster.
 Each racer in your Umamusume Records grants a bonus to all of your team members' attributes in subsequent Scout Races.

 Scout Point Bonus

 When you earn Scout Points, a bonus will be applied based on the number of racers in your Umamusume Records.

 Team Skills

 You can earn team skills by winning Scout Races with certain specific combinations of racers in your team.
 Once obtained, team skills can be used by all of your team members during Scout Races.

 Event Rewards

 Rating Rewards

 You can earn rewards for each new Team Rank you achieve by increasing your team's rating.

At 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 12 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jul 17 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 19 - 9:59 a.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Nakayama / Turf / 1,200m (Sprint) / Right-Handed / Outer / Summer / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.

As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Please be aware that once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the Daily Free 10x Scout event has begun!

 Each day you log in during this event, you will be able to perform a 10x scout on one of the currently available Scouts, up to a maximum of 10 times.
 Each free 10x scout becomes available every day at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible Scout changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Additionally, trainers will be able to use the Free Scout Stock function once during this event.

 Daily Free 10x Scout Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 2:59 p.m., Aug 1, 2026 (UTC)

 Daily Free 10x Scout Event Eligible Scout Availability Period

 • New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (UTC)

 • Spotlight Support Card Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jul 27 - 2:59 p.m., Aug 1, 2026 (UTC)

 About Free Scout Stock

 Free Scout Stock is a function that allows trainers to use the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event when logging in for the first time after it has begun.

 When Free Scout Stock is Applicable

 Free Scout Stock is applicable if:
 • If it is your first time logging in during the event
 Trainers can use all the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event up to that point.

 Example: If you do not log in between 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 and 9:59 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), and log in for the first time at 10:00 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), you can use 6 free 10x scouts on the Spotlight Support Card Scout.

 Free Scout Stock is not applicable if:
 • If you do not log in during the event; if you log in after the event has ended

 • If it is not your first time logging in during the event

 Important Information Regarding Free Scout Stock

 1. Free Scout Stock is only applicable once during the event.
 2. Free Scout Stock is applied after selecting "TAP TO START" on the title screen.
 Note: If the period during which Free Scout Stock can be used has already ended, you will be unable to use your accumulated free 10x scouts.
 3. Free Scout Stock for this event cannot be used after it has ended or in any future events. Additionally, the Free Scout Stock for any given day expires at 2:59 p.m. (UTC), even if the event has not ended.

 Important Information Regarding the Event

 1. Each free 10x scout becomes available at 3:00 p.m. (UTC). If you have not used the previous day's free scout at this time, it will be lost and cannot be carried over.
   2. The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible Scout changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Example: If you log in at 4:00 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), use your free 10x scout on the New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout, and the eligible Scout changes to the Spotlight Support Card Scout at 10:00 p.m. (UTC), you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for the new Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 3. If you have any free scouts remaining when this event ends, they will be lost. It is not possible to carry over free scouts to future events.
 4. There is no difference in scout rates between free scouts from this event and scouts performed on the same Scout using carats.
 5. To check the specific rates at which Support Cards appear from the New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Rates tab.
 6. Scouting while your scouts are being restored may cause an error.
 7. The availability period and event contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the new Career scenario "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" has been added to the game!
 In this new scenario, you can train your trainees using a different system than all previous Career scenarios.
 To get started with the new scenario, simply select Career from the Home screen, then select "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert"!

 "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" Story Outline

 Why do Umamusume sing for their fans? An event planner suggests rekindling the Grand Concert—inspiring the runners to find just what performances mean to them!
 Check out the newest Career scenario, featuring new characters and new systems!
 Revive the Grand Concert, a dream stage that all Umamusume can stand on!

 Scenario Systems

 Here's a sneak peek of the new systems you'll encounter in the "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" scenario!

 Grand Concert

 In this new Career scenario, your goal is to revive the Grand Concert.
 Four Promo Concerts and one Grand Concert are held, making for a total of five concerts.
 Work towards making things a great success by making each concert a spectacle!

 Concerts are held biannually starting from the second half of December during your trainee's junior year.
 Prepare for concerts during the period leading up to them and make them unforgettable!

 Performance and Lessons

 In this new Career scenario, you acquire Performance through activities like training and Career events.
 There are five types of Performance: Dance, Passion, Vocals, Visuals, and Composure.
 By spending Performance in lessons, you can acquire new songs and concert techniques.
 Songs and concert techniques don't just make concerts more exciting; they also have various effects, such as increasing your parameters, recovering energy, and boosting training effects.

 Live Performance Expectations

 By holding lessons and acquiring new songs as you work towards your next concert, your Live Performance Expectations will increase.
 When it reaches its max, your next concert will be a Great Success.
 Make sure to acquire plenty of songs and make your concert a Great Success!

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the new Career scenario, please refer to Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert under Career in Help.
2. The details of Career scenarios are subject to change without notice.

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Details

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Virgo Cup Platinum
 • Virgo Cup Gold
 • Virgo Cup Silver
 • Virgo Cup Bronze

 If you re-obtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Virgo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
An update was released at 11:00 a.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC).

 The details of the update are as follows:

 ■ Feature Updates

 New Features

 • An option to reroll Sparks at the end of a Career.
 • A new Photo Studio mode.
 • The ability to create a Club Card.
 • An option to transfer data using an iCloud backup.

 Updates to the URA Finale Scenario

 Training with Happy Meek


 Happy Meek will now appear as a training partner in this scenario.

 Dueling with Happy Meek


 When Happy Meek appears in training with a special icon, you can face off against her in a duel event after that training session.
 In this event, you can choose one of three contests (one based on the selected training type, and two chosen at random) and pit your trainee against Happy Meek based on a specific attribute or current Energy level.
 Each available contest is displayed with a prediction of the outcome.
 If you win the duel, your trainee will gain attributes, earn skill points, and obtain skill hints based on the chosen contest.
 As you win duels, future duels will increase in level and difficulty, but also offer greater attribute gains and skill point rewards.
 Try to compete with Happy Meek as much as possible to maximize the benefits!
 (Note: There is a limit to how far the level and difficulty of duels with Happy Meek can increase.)

 URA Finale Finals


 If your trainee defeats Happy Meek in enough duels over the course of a Career, Happy Meek will appear in the URA Finale Finals with increased abilities.
 Defeat this stronger Happy Meek to gain more attributes and skill points than normal, along with a new Rare Skill.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the URA Finale Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any skills from your duels with Happy Meek, the Sparks for these skills will be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.
 Try to train up a powerful racer who will be able to defeat Happy Meek at her strongest!

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 New Summer Camp Event


 The director will now visit your trainee with refreshments during summer camp in a new Energy-restoring event.

 Endings


 The attribute values and skill points obtained from certain endings have been adjusted.

 Updates to the Unity Cup Scenario

 Extreme Spirit Bursts


 Team members who have already triggered a Spirit Burst can now trigger an additional Extreme Spirit Burst once per Career.
 This special Spirit Burst provides a boost to that team member's attributes and attribute caps.
 What's more, in addition to gaining more from the training session than usual, your trainee can also earn a special skill hint.
 When an Extreme Spirit Burst is available, the failure rate for that training is reduced to 0%, so try to take advantage of them when they appear!

 Elite Teams


 If you fulfill certain conditions during a Career, you'll be able to face off against a special Elite Team.
 Defeating an Elite Team gives your trainee a big boost, so try to make sure your team is up to the task!
 The conditions to face an Elite Team are as follows:
 1. Your team is in the top 10 in the Unity Cup rankings
 2. Your Team Power is A or higher
 3. You have triggered at least one Extreme Spirit Burst

 Upgraded Team Zenith


 If you successfully defeat the Elite Team, Team Zenith will appear in the Unity Cup Finals with increased abilities.
 They won't be easy to defeat, so make sure to train up your whole team as much as possible!
 Defeating this more powerful Team Zenith will contribute greatly to your trainee's growth.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the Unity Cup Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any Ignited Spirit or Burning Spirit skills, the Sparks for these skills will also be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.

 New Team Power Rank: S+


 There is now an additional Team Power rank of S+ to achieve after the previous maximum of S.
 Achieving a Team Power of S+ will grant significant gains to your trainee.

 Retrying Unity Cup Races


 If you lose one of the team races that make up the Unity Cup, you will now have the option to consume an item to retry.
 When this option is selected, you can return to before the race and choose a different opposing team if you wish. When retrying, brackets will be reassigned, and the Mood of your aces will be increased by one level for the duration of the race.
 (Reassigned brackets are not guaranteed to be different from previous attempts.)

 Adjustments to Unity Training and Spirit Bursts


 The attribute values and skill points gained from Unity Training and Spirit Bursts have been adjusted.
 Unity Training and Spirit Bursts no longer require training to consume more Energy.
 Skill hints obtained from Spirit Bursts will now be selected from the skills of the team members who triggered them.

 Career Events


 The attribute values and skill points gained from certain Career Events have been adjusted.

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 Updates to Career

 • It is now possible to increase your trainee's attribute caps during a Career.
 (Attribute cap increase is dependent on the selected Career scenario and the outcome of Inspiration events. In addition, all attribute gains in excess of 1,200 will be halved.)
 • The Skip feature has been updated to progress more quickly during Career Events when set to the maximum speed.
 • Adjustments have been made to the text displayed in Career Events when obtaining a hint for a skill that has already been learned.

 Updates to Scouts

 • Added an option to use multiple scout tickets at once on the Scout screen.
 • Adjusted the UI for Make Debut Scouts.
 • Adjusted the conditions for certain animations in Pretty Derby Scouts.

 Updates to Daily Sales

 • Items will now be added to the Daily Sale shop cumulatively each time the conditions to trigger the shop are met. As this makes it unnecessary to close the shop, the button to do so has been removed.
 • Once triggered, the Daily Sale shop will now be available until the next daily reset at 3:00 p.m. (UTC), without the time limit that was previously applied.
 • It is now possible to buy multiple Daily Sale items at once by selecting them using checkboxes. There is also a Select All button to easily buy the entire stock.
[The Daily Sale function update will be applied from 3:00 p.m., July 3, 2026 (UTC).]

 Updates to Existing Features

 • Expanded the Friends feature to allow 10 additional follows.
 • Expanded the Veteran Umamusume list to allow 20 additional saved racers.
 • When viewing Umamusume details, it is now possible to flick or drag to scroll between Umamusume in the current list.
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by common Sparks.
 ("Common Sparks" refers collectively to Scenario Sparks, race Sparks, and skill Sparks.)
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by specific Unique Sparks.
 • Expanded Filter options for Support Cards to allow filtering by specific Support Effects.
 • Updated the Race Results screen with a new option to take photos.
 • Updated the Team Trials screen with a new Race History feature.
 (Race history can only be viewed for races that take place after this update.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to save and load concert lineups.
 (To use this feature, select the Presets button on the Concert Theater screen.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to apply costume changes to all performers at once.
 • Updated the Paid Carats Details screen to display a more detailed breakdown of purchased products and carat totals.
 • Expanded the Item Request feature in Clubs to allow the requesting of Winner's Sashes.
 • Updated the Race Events screen to display only events that are currently ongoing, upcoming, or in their reward collection period. Events that are not currently available will not appear.
 • Adjusted the unlock conditions for skill activation voices in Trainer Notes as follows:
 Before: Activate the relevant skill.
 After: Hear the voice line for the skill or raise the Trainee Umamusume to at least 3★.

 New Item

 • Added the new Gallery Key item.
(Gallery Keys will become available to obtain from 10:00 p.m., Jul 2, 2026 (UTC). Some are planned to be distributed as a gift, and they will also be added to the Friend Point Exchange lineup.)

 ■ Important Information
 1. It may take some time for the update to appear in the store.
 2. In addition, the update may fail in some cases due to the accumulation of temporary data on your device.
 If you are unable to update, please turn off your device, wait a minute or two, and then restart your device and update from the store.

raw.message:
As of 8:00 a.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the Independent Training function has been added to the game and can be used in all Career Scenarios!


■ About Independent Training
 Independent Training is a function that automatically advances a Career, completing it about 50 minutes after it starts.
 The Independent Training timer will progress even if you close the application.
 Additionally, content such as Umamusume Stories and races is playable by returning to the Home screen.
 (Unlike normal Career playthroughs, Independent Training has its own unique way of handling training and events that occur during the Career.)

 ■ Starting Independent Training
 Starting Independent Training remains the same as a normal Career up through editing your Support Card deck. During the Final Confirmation screen, Independent Training can be started by selecting the Independent Training tab and starting the playthrough.

 ■ Completing Independent Training
 When the remaining time reaches 0:00:00, you will be taken to the Complete Career screen, and your Independent Training log will display.
 The Independent Training log can be used to confirm info such as your Career results, score, obtained skill hints, and Inspiration records.
 After the Independent Training log is displayed, the rest of the Career completion process is the same as a normal Career.
 Points from all types of events, fans earned, Bond Level, and race rewards are obtained the same as in a normal Career.
 For more information, please check Independent Training from the Career tab under Menu in Help.

 ■ Important Information
 1. You cannot switch to a normal Career during Independent Training.
 2. Only epithets specific to Independent Training can be obtained.
 3. Goal achievement status per scenario will be treated using rules specific to Independent Training. Independent Training will continue even if goals haven't been completed.
 Additionally, you can still enter other race classes even if your trainee does not win her maiden race.
 4. In Independent Training, you cannot acquire trophies from winning races.
 5. In Independent Training, Career events and concerts cannot be viewed.
Because of this, nothing will unlock in the Concert Theater or Gallery.
 6. In Independent Training, missions tied to Career Scenarios, missions with requirements based on statistics that aren't displayed in the Independent Training log, as well as some other missions, will not progress.
 7. Career results will not be finalized until the Independent Training log is displayed. Results that depend on the completion of a Career playthrough, such as events and rewards with a daily limit, will be reflected once the Independent Training log displays for the first time.
raw.title: Introducing the Independent Training Feature
