Dear Trainers,
 Today we'd like to share with you a little bit about our plans for the English version of Umamusume: Pretty Derby.
 

Pacing

 First, you can expect to see all the same events and Scouts as in the Japanese version. However, we want you to experience the latest content sooner rather than later, so content will be released at a faster pace, with shorter gaps in between events and Scouts, but the durations of the events and Scouts themselves will be the same as they originally were in the Japanese version.
 

Expedited Features

 Second, the English version will have the following features available on release:
 • Landscape mode in races
 • Jukebox
 We also plan to selectively implement other new features and quality of life changes earlier than in the Japanese version going forward.
 For example, we are already working on the Guided Career feature, which the Japanese version didn't receive until its 4th anniversary. We'll keep you updated on when you can expect to see it in game.
 

Cross-Platform

 Lastly, the English version will feature cross-platform play between mobile and PC. You can use the same account to play on either platform.

 With your input and support, we hope to deliver a player-friendly experience to trainers around the globe. Thank you for your patience, and we'll see you at Tracen Academy.

 The Umamusume: Pretty Derby Team

Cygames has revealed the details for 7th Event: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES, the North American leg of Umamusume: Pretty Derby's world tour. The two-day concert is to be held in LA's Peacock Theater starting at 8:00 p.m., Oct 22 and 7:00 p.m., Oct 23, 2026 (PT). The key art and lineup are now live on the official website, and ticket sales will begin at 10:00 a.m., Jul 23, 2026 (PT).

7th EVENT: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES Lineup

 * List is subject to change.

7th EVENT: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES Ticketing Overview

Ticket sales will begin at 10:00 a.m., Jul 23, 2026 (PT) online via AXS and will be sold on a first-come, first-served basis. Prices vary by seating zone. Online streaming is also planned for the event.

Ticketing Details:

www.axs.com/events/1484017?skin=peacock

Prices by Seating Zone:

 -    VIP: $350 (1F frontal area, merch pack included)
 -    P1: $150
 -    P2: $100
 -    P3: $80

VIP Perks:

VIP tickets come bundled with a merch pack, which includes the following items packaged in an event-edition box and carrying bag:
 -    Figurine-Style Pin Set (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
 -    THE STAGE Band Shirt (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
 -    Commemorative Ticket (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
* Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual item designs may differ from the images shown.

-    The products included are the same for both days of the concert.
-    The band shirt comes in one size, roughly equivalent to an American XL. Measurements in inches:
       -    Length: 30.3–32.3
       -    Width: 23.2–24.0
       -    Shoulder: 21.7–22.0
       -    Sleeve: 8.3–10.2
-    The merch pack can only be picked up at the concert venue on the date of its bundled ticket. The pack will not be shipped, so please be sure to collect it in-person on the correct day.
-    The products in the merch pack cannot be returned or exchanged except in the case of defects.

Figurine-Style Pin Set Details:

A set of pins packaged in boxes reminiscent of collectible figurines. Display them in their original decorative boxes or take them out to use as pins.

THE STAGE Band Shirt Details:

A T-shirt with metallic details. The back features a list of all the Umamusume who will perform at the concert.

Commemorative Ticket Details:

An extra decorative replica of your ticket to keep as memorabilia. Made of paper.


Ticketing Schedule:

AMEX Presale:

10:00 a.m., Jul 23–10:00 p.m., Jul 24, 2026 (PT)
Use of an eligible American Express (AMEX) card at checkout is required to purchase AMEX presale tickets.

Goldenvoice Presale:

10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (PT)
Sign up for the Goldenvoice newsletter to receive a presale code.

Venue Presale:

10:00 a.m. – 10:00 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (PT)
Sign up for the Peacock Theater newsletter to receive a presale code.

General Sale:

Starts 10:00 a.m., Jul 28, 2026 (PT)
Tickets available while stock lasts. An AXS account is required.
